title: BRITTLE MATERIAL VALVES
docs.abstract: Some aspects of the disclosure provide a valve system that includes a valve made of brittle material, such as ceramic, graphite and the like. In some examples, the valve is made of one or more materials that remain a solid state in a temperature range of 1000°C to 3000°C. The valve includes a valve housing with a cavity extending in a length direction of the valve. The valve housing includes a first port aligned with the cavity and a second port that is formed on a side of the cavity. The valve includes a plunger that is movable in the cavity of the valve housing and configured to control a fluid flow between the first port and the second port. Methods of forming the valve and operating the valve are also provided.

title: BRITTLE MATERIAL JOINTS WITH DYNAMIC SEALING
docs.abstract: A joint structure may include a first component and a second component aligned in a first direction, where a first end of the first component is opposed to a first end of the second component. The joint structure may include a packing shell positioned around the first end of the first component and the first end of the second component such that the first component is inserted into the packing shell from the first end and the second component is inserted into the packing shell from the first end. The joint structure may include a first sealing element positioned between the packing shell and the first end of the first component and further extending into the packing shell. The joint structure may include a second sealing element positioned between the packing shell and the first end of the second component and further extending into the packing shell.

title: CIRCULATION PUMP MADE FROM BRITTLE MATERIAL
docs.abstract: Aspect of the disclosure provides a method of pumping a liquid material. The method may include pumping the liquid material by rotating an impeller attached to a shaft assembly. The pump includes the impeller, the shaft assembly, and a pump chamber. The method includes controlling the minimum pressure of the liquid material in the pump chamber to be above a threshold pressure by controlling a pressure of a gas that is supplied to the pump chamber. The shaft assembly includes a first shaft and a second shaft that are separated by a gap and are physically coupled by a coupling component.

title: THERMAL BATTERY SYSTEMS COMPRISING EMITTER UNITS EQUIPPED WITH VAPOR BARRIERS
docs.abstract: Described herein are thermal battery systems comprising emitter units equipped with vapor barriers. A vapor barrier prevents vapors (e.g., released by the emitter base during its heating) from reaching a TPV receiver when the TPV receiver is inserted inside the emitter unit. For example, the emitter base may comprise graphite, while the vapor barrier may comprise tungsten (at least on the TPV-facing surface). At the emitter unit's operating temperature of about 2000°C, the vapor pressure of tungsten is about 10,000 times lower than that of graphite (e.g., 10-7 Pa vs. 10-3 Pa). As such, the graphite emitter base may release appreciable amounts of vapors, which (if not blocked) can deposit on the TPV receiver (operating at less than 100°C even when inside the emitter unit cavity). The vapor barrier blocks this vapor from reaching the cavity, while the emitter base provides mechanical support to the vapor barrier.

title: 由脆性材料制成的循环泵
docs.abstract: 本公开的方面提供了一种泵送液体材料的方法。该方法可以包括通过使附接于轴组件的叶轮旋转来泵送液体材料。泵包括叶轮、轴组件和泵室。该方法包括通过控制供应到泵室的气体的压力来控制泵室中的液体材料的最小压力高于阈值压力。轴组件包括由间隙分离并通过联接部件物理地联接的第一轴和第二轴。

title: 一种带互感器的柜体封堵装置
docs.abstract: 本发明涉及柜体封堵技术领域，具体为一种带互感器的柜体封堵装置，包括安装板，所述安装板的前端面活动连接有外壳，所述外壳的内部开设有环形结构的安装腔，所述安装腔内固定有环形结构的互感器主体，所述外壳呈环形结构设计，中间设置有供线缆插接的固定孔，所述固定孔内壁设置有夹持防尘机构；夹持防尘机构包括与固定孔内壁固定胶接的防尘气囊，所述安装板与固定孔对应位置开设有与固定孔尺寸一致的穿插孔。本申请通过夹持防尘机构配合驱动机构一配合能够对穿插在装置内部的线缆实现柔性夹持固定，避免线缆受外界环境影响造成晃动而出现磨损断裂的情况发生，并且通过防尘气囊包裹填充线缆与固定孔的安装缝隙进一步提高装置的防尘效果。
